Definitions for the participation and revenue metrics

Source: R/metrics.R
metric_definitions.Rd

These definitions are accounting identities on the city extract. They are not posted prices, tee-sheet utilization, or causal effects of a price change.

Usage

metric_definitions()

Value

A tibble with one row per metric.

Examples

metric_definitions()
#> # A tibble: 9 × 4
#>   metric                           formula                   use   do_not_use_as
#>   <chr>                            <chr>                     <chr> <chr>

#> 5 green_fee_per_played_round       green-fee revenue on row… Real… A posted gre…

#> 7 green_fee_per_daylight_round     green-fee revenue, inclu… Gree… Revenue per …
